Title: Architecture review gate B
Purpose: Review the interactive sandbox concept before automation and final proof work proceeds.
Deliverables: Gate B review memo with explicit go/no-go decision.
Readability assessment for the interactive guided 3D scene and whether the concept justifies final automation/proof work.
Trigger for scene/layout corrective work if the concept is visually or semantically wrong.
ReviewQuestions: Does depth reduce clutter or just introduce occlusion?
Are move/connect flows worth carrying into an automation surface?
Is the concept still clearly branch-isolated and non-persistent?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If this task fails, stop immediately and execute `subbundles/_corrective-scene-contract-and-layout-reset` before continuing.
